listing.name: Mickey's Wild Adventure — Mickeywildadventurerecomp (sernikigierki-commits)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Custom story/continue/save protection, practice mode, frontend and input; no full playthrough claim. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European SCES-00163 CUE with all 28 referenced BIN tracks. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Recomp Build Studio to check your game folder, prepare OpenBIOS and the game, and build a local package. Start it with RUN_GAME.bat or RUN_GAME.sh. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
